toegepas.rede_vinder: With three areas and 'Die derde gebied' following, 'eerste' reads better than 'een'.
toegepas.fout: 'Die een ... die ander ... Die derde' counts three areas with a pairing pattern meant for two, so the third area arrives awkwardly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die eerste' sets up a clean count to 'Die derde' without changing which areas are named.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die ander' implies the other of two, but there are three areas; 'die tweede' fits the count.
toegepas.fout: 'die ander' suggests the other of two, but a third area follows in the next sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'die tweede' fits the three-part count and leaves the places and meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: As a regional name, Sentraal-Afrika takes a capital, like Suidoos-Asië in the next sentence.
toegepas.fout: A compass or region word joined to a geographical name by a hyphen is capitalised, as 'Suidoos-Asie' is in the next sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Plain spelling fix that also makes the two region names consistent.

toegepas.blok: Wat die kaarte van die reënwoude wys
toegepas.voor: Twee soorte kaart saam sê dus
toegepas.na: Saam wys die twee soorte kaarte dus
toegepas.rede_vinder: The original word order is stiff; this is more natural and matches the block's use of 'wys' for maps.
toegepas.fout: 'Twee soorte kaart saam se dus' is stiff word order, and maps 'show' rather than 'say' in natural Afrikaans.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal reads naturally, keeps the same two maps and the same conclusion, and touches no protected wording.

toegepas.blok: Bome wat in lae bo mekaar staan
toegepas.voor: op tot hoog by die blaredak
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'tot hoog by' is unidiomatic; 'tot by die blaredak' already says the plants reach the high canopy.
toegepas.fout: 'tot hoog by die blaredak' is an unidiomatic construction.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'tot by die blaredak' is the natural expression, and the canopy is already high by definition, so nothing is lost.

toegepas.blok: Diere wat in die bome leef
toegepas.voor: Die toekan pluk vrugte in die takke met sy groot bek.
toegepas.na: Die toekan pluk met sy groot bek vrugte in die takke.
toegepas.rede_vinder: At the end of the sentence 'met sy groot bek' seems to attach to 'die takke'; moving it removes the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: Placing 'met sy groot bek' after the place phrase runs against the usual Afrikaans manner-before-place order and lets it hang on 'die takke'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Moving the manner phrase forward reads more naturally with the same actor, action, object and place.

toegepas.blok: Wat hierdie streek sy eie maak
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma is needed.
toegepas.fout: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Die temperature bly' and 'daar is') without the AWS 2017 comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Required AWS comma; wording and meaning are unchanged.

na_skrywer.blok: Wat hierdie streek sy eie maak
na_skrywer.voor: Warm én nat in elke maand van die jaar maak hierdie streek sy eie.
na_skrywer.na: Hierdie streek se kenmerk is dat dit in elke maand van die jaar warm én nat is.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'iets sy eie maak' is an anglicism; in Afrikaans it means to take something over, not to make it distinctive.
na_skrywer.fout: 'iets sy eie maak' means to adopt or take something over in Afrikaans, not to make it distinctive; the same anglicism also stands in the block heading 'Wat hierdie streek sy eie maak'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but fixing only the sentence leaves the heading with the same anglicism, so the writer should repair the heading and its opening sentence together.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Wat hierdie streek sy eie maak
vlae.teks: Wat hierdie streek sy eie maak
vlae.rede: The block heading has the same anglicism ('sy eie maak'); a heading cannot be changed by the script, so the writer should rephrase it, e.g. along the lines of what sets the region apart.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Party maande kry meer reën as ander en daardie verskil is soms groot
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Under AWS 2017 this needs a comma before 'en' (two clauses each with their own subject and verb: 'Party maande kry' and 'daardie verskil is'). The protected wording leaves it out; a person could add the comma to the protected entry and the lesson together.
